Create xts addfactor

addf.Rd

Create xts addfactor

Usage

addf(
  start = bank_start(),
  end = bank_end(),
  from = 0,
  to = 0,
  ser_name = "value",
  per = "year",
  ...
)

Arguments

start

start date of linear interpolation (character: "yyyy-mm-dd", "yyyyqq", "yyyy"), or a data frame of ramps with columns start, end, from, to (one ramp per row; see details)

end

end date of linear interpolation (character: "yyyy-mm-dd", "yyyyqq", "yyyy")

from

first value for linear interpolation (numeric)

to

last value for linear interpolation (numeric)

ser_name

name of the xts series (string)

per

periodicity of series (character: "year" - default) if start is written as a quarter or a month (see to_ymd()), per is set to "quarter" or "month"

...

with formulas: further points (see details)

Value

a single xts series spanning the bank: from getOption("fcutils.bnk_start") to getOption("fcutils.bnk_end") (see make_xts())

Details

this is a wrapper around make_xts with some additional functionality. the start and end dates specify the span of the non-zero add-factor value. the remaining period between start and end is filled with zeros.

Given a data frame of ramps, addf() builds one add-factor per row and returns their sum, so overlapping ramps add up. A data frame with no rows gives zeros over the bank. The dates take any form to_ymd() reads, decimal years included, but a column must be all numbers or all strings.

Given formulas, addf(2026.3 ~ 0, 2027.4 ~ -0.3, 2030.4 ~ 0), the add-factor runs through the points in straight lines, one equal step per period, and is zero before the first point and after the last. Each formula has a date on the left and a value on the right. The frequency follows the first date (2026.3 is a quarter), unless per is given by name; ser_name and per must be named. Decimal dates are quarters, so monthly points need strings ("2026M10" ~ 1).

Examples

options(fcutils.bnk_start = as.Date("1970-01-01"), fcutils.bnk_end = as.Date("2070-12-31"))
addf()
#>            value
#> 1970-01-01     0
#> 1971-01-01     0
#> 1972-01-01     0
#> 1973-01-01     0
#> 1974-01-01     0
#> 1975-01-01     0
#> 1976-01-01     0
#> 1977-01-01     0
#> 1978-01-01     0
#> 1979-01-01     0
#>        ...      
#> 2061-01-01     0
#> 2062-01-01     0
#> 2063-01-01     0
#> 2064-01-01     0
#> 2065-01-01     0
#> 2066-01-01     0
#> 2067-01-01     0
#> 2068-01-01     0
#> 2069-01-01     0
#> 2070-01-01     0
addf(201002, 201504, 1, 2)
#>            value
#> 1970-01-01     0
#> 1970-04-01     0

#> 1971-01-01     0

#> 2069-07-01     0
#> 2069-10-01     0
#> 2070-01-01     0
#> 2070-04-01     0
#> 2070-07-01     0
#> 2070-10-01     0
addf(20100101, 20601201, 1, 2, per = "month")

#> 1970-01-01     0
